typography.hint: Line spacing and paragraph spacing apply to the reading area. Paragraph spacing is the blank space between two paragraphs in pixels; Qt's own default is about 24, so 24 means the original look.
typography.locked: {fields} currently come from the active theme ("Typography follows theme" is on and the theme provides them). Turn that switch off to adjust them here.

voice.empty_neural: (no offline voice downloaded yet — use “Manage voices…” below)
voice.hint: Voices come with the speech engine: system voices, offline models and online voices are three separate sets, and switching engines switches the list. Double-click a row to use it (online voices need internet).

timer.label: Timer
timer.custom_prompt: Stop reading after how many minutes?

range.hint: Reads from the first chapter through the end of the last one, finishing every chapter in between. The range applies once: it goes back to the whole chapter when it is done.
range.no_selection: Select some text in the reading area first.
range.cursor_empty: There is nothing left to read after the cursor.
range.empty: This range has nothing to read.

model.hint: Offline voices work without internet, but the model has to be downloaded first (once, and it can be resumed).
model.busy: Another model is downloading — wait for it or cancel it first.

model.ask_remove: Deleting “{name}” means downloading it again later ({size}). Delete it?

model.offline: The network is unavailable, download failed. Check the connection and try again.
model.mirror: Direct download failed, retrying through a mirror…
model.broken: The downloaded archive is incomplete (the connection may have dropped). Please try again.

error.voice_missing: No voice selected yet — pick one first.

about.title: About

Click a key field and press the new shortcut to rebind it; press Delete to clear a binding.

file_open.label: Open File
file_open.hint: Open a book file such as epub / txt

file_open_folder.label: Open Folder
file_open_folder.hint: Read multiple books continuously in folder mode

nav_prev_chapter.label: Previous Chapter
nav_prev_chapter.hint: Works when the reading area has focus (page key)

nav_next_chapter.label: Next Chapter
nav_next_chapter.hint: Works when the reading area has focus (page key)

nav_reader_prev.label: Previous Chapter (Arrow)
nav_reader_prev.hint: Works when the reading area has focus (Left)

nav_reader_next.label: Next Chapter (Arrow)
nav_reader_next.hint: Works when the reading area has focus (Right)

nav_goto_chapter.label: Go to Chapter
nav_goto_chapter.hint: Jump by chapter number within the current file

nav_chapter_start.label: Chapter Start
nav_chapter_start.hint: Back to the beginning of this chapter

nav_chapter_end.label: Chapter End
nav_chapter_end.hint: Jump to the end of this chapter

tts_play_pause.label: Start/Pause Reading
tts_play_pause.hint: Works when the reading area has focus (Space)

tts_stop.label: Stop Reading
tts_stop.hint: Stop and rewind to the start of the current sentence (unbound by default)

tts_prev_sentence.label: Previous Sentence
tts_prev_sentence.hint: Go back one sentence; restarts the current one right after speaking starts

tts_next_sentence.label: Next Sentence
tts_next_sentence.hint: Skip to the next sentence when the reader runs ahead of you

tts_rate_up.label: Speak Faster
tts_rate_up.hint: Step the speaking rate up (slowest to fastest)

tts_rate_down.label: Speak Slower
tts_rate_down.hint: Step the speaking rate down (fastest to slowest)

tts_range_chapter.label: Read the Whole Chapter
tts_range_chapter.hint: Reread the whole chapter from its start (unbound by default)

tts_range_cursor.label: Read From the Cursor
tts_range_cursor.hint: Start at the sentence under the cursor and stop at the chapter end (unbound by default)

tts_range_selection.label: Read Selected Text Only

tts_range_chapters.label: Read a Chapter Range

view_toggle_sidebar.label: Show/Hide Chapter List

merge.title: Same Book Detected - {app}
merge.hint: These records look like the same book you are opening (same title, matching opening chapter titles). Sharing progress syncs both ways: chapters read, last position, and time read. Choose "Keep Separate" to leave each record on its own.
merge.hint_weak: These records have the same title as the book you are opening, but its chapters are auto-numbered so they cannot be compared by title. Sharing progress syncs both ways: chapters read, last position, and time read. If this is a different book, choose "Keep Separate".
merge.more_versions: {count} more similar records are not shown.
merge.dont_ask: Remember this choice and do not ask again for this book
